📋 12 Entry Points

Programme

Dreadnought Programme AI

Dreadnought-class SSBN programme oversight — four-boat build schedule (Boats 1–4). Barrow-in-Furness construction milestone tracking. BAE Systems submarine delivery contract management. Programme cost monitoring against £31bn+ budget envelope. Nuclear propulsion system integration governance. Astute-class parallel build coordination. Vanguard-to-Dreadnought transition planning. Continuous At-Sea Deterrent (CASD) handover risk management.

AUKUS

AUKUS Integration AI

AUKUS Pillar I nuclear-powered submarine collaboration — SSN-AUKUS design and build pathway. UK–Australia technology transfer governance under bilateral treaty. US Virginia-class technology transfer under ITAR. Australian submarine construction yard readiness assessment. Joint work force training programme (Pine Gap, Barrow, Adelaide). Common combat system integration. Propulsion technology sharing protocols. Export control and classification management across three nations.

Safety

Nuclear Safety Governance AI

ONR (Office for Nuclear Regulation) licence condition compliance. Nuclear safety case management for Dreadnought-class reactor systems. Defence Nuclear Safety Regulator (DNSR) oversight. Radiation exposure monitoring and ALARA compliance. Submarine reactor refuelling and defuelling protocols. Nuclear waste management and disposal (Sellafield pathway). Emergency response and nuclear accident scenario modelling. INLA (Independent Nuclear Safety Assessment) lifecycle governance.

Supply Chain

Supply Chain Sovereignty AI

UK sovereign submarine component sourcing — critical raw materials (HMS Sheffield steel, reactor-grade materials). Tier 1–4 supplier mapping across SDA supply chain. BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce, Babcock prime contractor governance. Single-source supplier risk identification and mitigation. Sovereign capability preservation for nuclear submarine systems. Foreign ownership, control, or influence (FOCI) screening. Export control (ITAR/EAR) compliance across supply chain. Just-in-time logistics for Barrow shipyard operations.

Workforce

Workforce Skills Pipeline AI

Submarine build workforce skills pipeline — 10,000+ skilled trades at peak. Nuclear-qualified welder, pipe-fitter, and electrician training. SDA graduate and apprentice intake management (800+/yr). Security-cleared workforce planning and development. NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) certification tracking. Defence nuclear skills retention programme. Cross-shipyard workforce mobility (Barrow, Devonport, Faslane, Rosyth). Diversity and inclusion in nuclear submarine workforce.

Digital

Digital Shipyard AI

Barrow-in-Furness digital shipyard transformation — Building Information Modelling (BIM) for submarine construction. Digital twin of Dreadnought-class hull and systems. 3D design-to-manufacture integration. Automated welding and inspection robotics. Real-time construction progress monitoring. Supply chain digital thread from design through commissioning. Cyber-physical system integration on the production line. Shipyard layout optimisation using simulation.

Through-Life

Through-Life Support AI

Submarine through-life cost optimisation — 30+ year operational lifespan management. Planned maintenance periods (PMPs) at Devonport and Faslane. Refit and refuelling schedule governance. Obsolescence management for legacy systems. Predictive maintenance using sensor data analytics. Spare parts inventory optimisation across UK submarine bases. Decommissioning cost forecasting for Vanguard-class. Submarine disposal programme (SDP) planning.

Environmental

Environmental Compliance AI

Nuclear submarine environmental impact governance — MOD nuclear liabilities annual reporting. Marine environment protection in Clyde, Devonport, and Barrow. Radioactive discharge monitoring and SEPA/EA compliance. Submarine decommissioning environmental assessment. Biodiversity impact of naval base operations. Carbon footprint tracking for submarine construction. Noise and vibration management at shipyards and bases. Habitats Directive compliance for marine construction zones.

Security

Security Vetting AI

Defence security vetting for SDA personnel — Developed Vetting (DV) and Security Check (SC) processing. STRAP material handling authorisation. Nuclear security clearance management. Personnel security risk assessment automation. Foreign contact and travel declaration processing. Counter-intelligence threat integration. Security incident reporting and investigation pipeline. AUKUS trilateral security protocol harmonisation.

Industrial Base

Industrial Base Resilience AI

UK submarine industrial base capacity monitoring — shipyard throughput and bottleneck detection. Critical component production capacity (reactor casings, pressure hull sections). Submarine supply chain stress-testing under disruption scenarios. Strategic stockpile management for sovereign materials. Manufacturing technology modernisation pipeline. Industrial base investment prioritisation. Foreign acquisition vulnerability assessment. Emergency surge production capability assessment.

Data

Data Governance AI

SDA data governance and information assurance — OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE to SECRET data classification management. MOD Information Assurance (IS1/IS2) compliance. Cross-domain solution governance for multinational data sharing. Data quality monitoring across programme management systems. Audit trail integrity for financial and programme data. AUKUS trilateral data exchange protocol compliance. Parliamentary data release governance. Open data publication for non-sensitive programme information.

Parliamentary

Parliamentary Oversight AI

Parliamentary accountability for SDA operations — NAO (National Audit Office) report preparation. PAC (Public Accounts Committee) evidence management. Written Parliamentary Questions (PQ) response automation. Defence Committee inquiry evidence compilation. Annual SDA performance report generation. Public interest disclosure management. Freedom of Information (FOI) response governance. Ministerial briefing material preparation.

⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Digital Submarine Programme

End-to-end digital programme management for Dreadnought-class construction. Integrated schedule, cost, and risk management platform. Real-time construction progress dashboards. Automated earned value management (EVM). Target £2bn+ cost avoidance through digital programme governance by 2030.

2. AUKUS Pillar I Technical Integration

AUKUS trilateral submarine technology integration platform. Joint design authority digital collaboration. Common component specification and test protocol management. ITAR/EAR export control automation. Three-nation supply chain harmonisation. Target 2028 SSN-AUKUS preliminary design review digital readiness.

3. Nuclear Safety AI Governance

AI-assisted nuclear safety case development and management. ONR licence condition compliance monitoring automation. Safety incident near-miss trend analysis. Radiation exposure tracking and ALARA optimisation. Emergency response simulation integration. Target 99.8% nuclear safety compliance rate across all SDA sites.

4. Sovereign Supply Chain Intelligence

End-to-end supply chain visibility across SDA programmes. FOCI screening automation for all Tier 1–4 suppliers. Critical raw materials sourcing sovereignty mapping. Supply chain disruption early-warning system. Just-in-time logistics optimisation for Barrow shipyard. Target 100% critical component UK-sovereign sourcing by 2032.

5. Workforce Skills Pipeline

Digital workforce planning and skills development platform. Nuclear-qualified tradesman certification tracking. Apprentice-to-competency digital pathway management. Security vetting integration with HR systems. Cross-shipyard workforce allocation optimisation. Target 12,000+ security-cleared submarine-build workforce by 2030.

6. Digital Twin Shipyard

Barrow digital shipyard BIM-to-manufacture integration. Dreadnought-class hull section digital twin. Automated quality inspection using computer vision. Weld quality tracking and NDT integration. Real-time construction progress vs. 3D model comparison. Target 30% rework reduction through digital twin quality governance.

7. Through-Life Cost Optimisation

Predictive maintenance analytics for UK submarine fleet. Spare parts demand forecasting using operational data. Refit scheduling optimisation at Devonport and Faslane. Obsolescence early-warning and technology insertion planning. Vanguard decommissioning cost modelling. Target 15% through-life cost reduction across Dreadnought programme.

8. Industrial Base Resilience Monitoring

Continuous industrial base capacity and capability monitoring. Shipyard throughput bottleneck detection and resolution. Critical component surge production scenario planning. Strategic stockpile adequacy assessment. Foreign acquisition vulnerability early-warning. Target 95% industrial base resilience score across all submarine programmes.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No nuclear safety shortcuts — every safety case must meet ONR and DNSR standards with full independent assessment before any reactor system operation
  • ❌ No non-UK nuclear propulsion IP sharing without bilateral treaty authorisation at ministerial level and Parliamentary scrutiny
  • ❌ No security vetting bypass — every SDA personnel member must hold appropriate clearance (DV/SC) before access to classified submarine programme information
  • ❌ No AUKUS technology transfer exceeding treaty scope — ITAR/EAR export control compliance mandatory for all three-nation exchanges
  • ❌ No submarine construction milestone acceptance without documented quality assurance sign-off from MOD Defence Equipment & Support (DE&S)
  • ❌ No single-source supply chain dependency without identified sovereign UK alternative or strategic stockpile sufficient for programme continuity

🤝 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery: Map SDA programme portfolio (~£40bn+ total value). Assess Dreadnought construction progress across four boats. Benchmark AUKUS integration readiness. Profile industrial base capacity and workforce pipeline. Identify nuclear safety governance maturity. Map supply chain sovereignty gaps.
2
Governance Design: Deploy DEFONEOS MCP servers against SDA programme use cases. Configure Dreadnought, AUKUS, nuclear safety, and supply chain governance protocols. Establish submarine programme governance framework aligned with MOD standards.
3
Pilot: Run 90-day pilot across Barrow shipyard and DE&S Submarine Delivery Team. Measure programme governance uplift, safety compliance enhancement, and supply chain visibility improvement. Collect SDA leadership, ONR, and contractor feedback.
4
Scale: Roll out across all SDA operations nationally. Integrate with DE&S, DIO, and Defence Nuclear Organisation platforms. Deploy across BAE Systems, Rolls-Royce, and Babcock submarine ecosystems. AUKUS trilateral integration pathway.
5
Assure: Continuous audit-grade SDA governance reporting. Nuclear safety compliance transparency dashboards. Parliamentary evidence generation. Programme cost and schedule performance metrics. Industrial base resilience monitoring.
